options.name: --model
options.description: Specify which TTS model to use. We recommend `s2-pro`. [default: S2Pro]

options.name: --text
options.description: Text to convert to speech.

options.name: --temperature
options.description: Controls expressiveness. Higher is more varied, lower is more consistent.

options.name: --top-p
options.description: Controls diversity via nucleus sampling.

options.name: --references
options.description: Inline voice references for zero-shot cloning. Requires MessagePack (not JSON). For single speaker, provide an array of ReferenceAudio objects. For multiple speakers, provide an array of arrays where each inner array contains references for one speaker. **Multi-speaker is only available with the S2-Pro model.** The speaker index corresponds to the index in reference_id array. Example for multi-speaker: [[{audio, text}], [{audio, text}, {audio, text}]] for 2 speakers where speaker 1 has 2 reference samples.

options.name: --reference-id
options.description: Voice model ID(s) from Fish Audio library or your custom models. For single-speaker synthesis, provide a string. For multi-speaker synthesis (dialogue), provide an array of model IDs. **Multi-speaker is only available with the S2-Pro model.** When using multiple speakers, use speaker tags in your text like `<|speaker:0|>` and `<|speaker:1|>` to indicate speaker changes. Example: `<|speaker:0|>Hello!<|speaker:1|>Hi there!<|speaker:0|>How are you?` with `reference_id: ["speaker-a-id", "speaker-b-id"]`.

options.name: --chunk-length
options.description: Text segment size for processing.

options.name: --normalize
options.description: Normalizes text for English and Chinese, improving stability for numbers. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output audio format.

options.name: --sample-rate
options.description: Audio sample rate in Hz. When null, uses the format's default (44100 Hz for most formats, 48000 Hz for opus).

options.name: --mp3-bitrate
options.description: MP3 bitrate in kbps. Only applies when format is mp3.

options.name: --opus-bitrate
options.description: Opus bitrate in bps. -1000 for automatic. Only applies when format is opus.

options.name: --latency
options.description: Latency-quality trade-off. normal: best quality, balanced: reduced latency, low: lowest latency.

options.name: --max-new-tokens
options.description: Maximum audio tokens to generate per text chunk.

options.name: --repetition-penalty
options.description: Penalty for repeating audio patterns. Values above 1.0 reduce repetition.

options.name: --min-chunk-length
options.description: Minimum characters before splitting into a new chunk.

options.name: --condition-on-previous-chunks
options.description: Use previous audio as context for voice consistency. Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.

options.name: --early-stop-threshold
options.description: Early stopping threshold for batch processing.

options.name: --prosody-speed
options.description: Speaking rate multiplier. Valid range: 0.5 to 2.0. 1.0 = normal speed, 0.5 = half speed, 2.0 = double speed. Useful for adjusting pacing without regenerating audio.

options.name: --prosody-volume
options.description: Volume adjustment in decibels (dB). 0 = no change, positive values = louder, negative values = quieter.

options.name: --prosody-normalize-loudness
options.description: Normalize output loudness for more consistent perceived volume. **S2-Pro only.** Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.
